correctness.rationale: The exact facet-incidence formula is derived from all 14 supporting facets and forces the 6/8/10 support. The ten-gonal event reduces to one spherical triangle per 48 sectors with determinant 1 and strictly positive denominator; its solid angle is evaluated analytically. All 36 length-sqrt(2) edges have endpoint angle arccos(4/5), so an exact sign-separation expectation supplies the mean. Linear normalization plus mean fixes the remaining masses uniquely. The standalone original package checker separately reconstructs 24 vertices and 36 edges, compares 9983 generic integer normals, verifies a 6-triangle spherical dissection and samples 200000 normals. Boundary planes have Haar measure zero.

value.rationale: The truncated octahedron is a canonical Archimedean solid and the body-centered-cubic Voronoi cell. Central-plane random sections are a natural stereological observable. This determines its complete polygon-side distribution, including a nontrivial decagonal probability, using a structural decomposition into facet-incidence chambers and a mean edge-crossing identity. The object is not an arbitrary slice and these probabilities are not read off from a known table or from a generic halfspace inequality; the full three-point law is a motivated exact finite invariant. Its value is mathematical completeness and a transparent bridge between spherical cone geometry and section topology, not a claimed downstream theorem.
